name: Fishermen First Web Application
description: Rebuild Fishermen First Rockfish Platform as a production-grade Next.js web application. See tasks/prd-fishermen-first-web-app.md for complete domain context, database schema, business rules, and file format specifications. Tech stack: Next.js 14, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Supabase, Vercel. Quality gates: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit.

userStories.title: Initialize Next.js Project with TypeScript
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a properly configured Next.js 14 project so that I can build the application with type safety.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 app router project created in `web/` directory
ESLint + Prettier configured with consistent rules
Tailwind CSS configured with brand colors (#1e3a5f navy)

userStories.title: Configure Supabase Client
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Supabase client utilities so that I can interact with the database and auth.
acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript types generated from database schema

userStories.title: Install and Configure shadcn/ui
userStories.description: As a developer, I want shadcn/ui components available so that I can build consistent, accessible interfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Base components installed: Button, Card, Input, Select, Table, Dialog, Badge, Tabs, Toast
Theme configured with Fishermen First brand colors

userStories.title: Create Application Layout Shell
userStories.description: As a user, I want a consistent layout with navigation so that I can move between features.
acceptanceCriteria: Root layout with header (logo, user menu)
Sidebar navigation component with role-based menu items
Sidebar shows: Dashboard, Transfers, Alerts, Upload, Rosters, Allocations (manager/admin)
Sidebar shows: My Vessel, Report Bycatch (vessel_owner)
Responsive: sidebar collapses on smaller screens

userStories.title: Set Up TanStack Query
userStories.description: As a developer, I want TanStack Query configured so that I can manage server state efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: React Query DevTools in development only
Custom hooks pattern established in `hooks/` directory

userStories.title: Create Login Page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to log in with email and password so that I can access the platform.
acceptanceCriteria: Email input with validation (valid email format)
Sign In button with loading state
Error message display for invalid credentials
Redirect to dashboard on successful login
Brand styling with navy color scheme

userStories.title: Create Password Reset Flow
userStories.description: As a user, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access if I forget it.
acceptanceCriteria: Success message: Check your email for reset link
Password requirements displayed (8+ chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number)
Redirect to login on successful reset

userStories.title: Implement Auth Middleware
userStories.description: As a developer, I want route protection so that unauthorized users cannot access protected pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Middleware checks auth status on protected routes
Authenticated users redirected from `/login` to dashboard
Role stored in middleware context for route guards

userStories.title: Create Auth Context and Hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want auth utilities so that components can access user information.
acceptanceCriteria: `useAuth()` hook returns: user, role, org_id, llp, isLoading
Auth state persists across page refreshes
Logout function clears session and redirects to login

userStories.title: Create User Menu Component
userStories.description: As a user, I want a user menu in the header so that I can see my account and log out.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows user email and role badge
Logout clears session and redirects to login

userStories.title: Create Dashboard Page Structure
userStories.description: As a manager, I want a dashboard page so that I can monitor fleet quota status.

userStories.title: Build KPI Summary Cards
userStories.description: As a manager, I want KPI cards at the top of the dashboard so that I can see fleet-wide metrics at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: 5 cards in a row: Total Vessels, Critical Risk Count, POP %, NR %, Dusky %
Total Vessels shows count of active LLPs
Critical Risk shows vessels with any species <10% remaining (red styling)
Species cards show: remaining lbs + percentage of total allocation
Cards have subtle shadow and border

userStories.title: Build At-Risk Vessels Panel
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to see at-risk vessels highlighted so that I can prioritize attention.
acceptanceCriteria: Panel below KPI cards titled Vessels Needing Attention
Shows top 7 vessels sorted by lowest % remaining
Each row: colored dot (red<10%, yellow 10-50%, green>50%), vessel name, LLP, lowest %
Clicking a vessel filters the main table to that vessel
View All link scrolls to main table

userStories.title: Create Quota Data Table
userStories.description: As a manager, I want a sortable table of all vessel quotas so that I can analyze fleet status.
acceptanceCriteria: Table columns: Co-Op, Vessel, LLP, Species, Allocation, Remaining, % Remaining
All columns sortable (click header to toggle)
% Remaining column color-coded by risk level

userStories.title: Add Dashboard Filters
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to filter the dashboard by cooperative and vessel so that I can focus on specific data.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter row above table with: Co-Op dropdown, Vessel dropdown, Species multi-select
Co-Op dropdown: All Cooperatives + list of coops
Vessel dropdown: cascades based on selected co-op
Species: checkboxes for POP, NR, Dusky (all selected by default)
Clear Filters button resets to defaults
Filters apply to both at-risk panel and main table
Filter state preserved in URL query params

userStories.title: Implement Dashboard Data Fetching
userStories.description: As a developer, I want efficient data fetching for the dashboard so that it loads quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: API route: `GET /api/quota/remaining` returns paginated table data

userStories.title: Add CSV Export to Dashboard
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to export dashboard data to CSV so that I can analyze it in Excel.
acceptanceCriteria: Exports all filtered data (not just current page)
Button shows loading state during generation

userStories.title: Create Transfers Page Structure
userStories.description: As a manager, I want a transfers page so that I can manage quota movements between vessels.
acceptanceCriteria: Two sections: Transfer Form (top), Transfer History (bottom)

userStories.title: Build Transfer Form
userStories.description: As a manager, I want a transfer form so that I can move quota between vessels.
acceptanceCriteria: Card with form fields in 2-column grid
From LLP dropdown: shows LLP - Vessel Name format
To LLP dropdown: same format, excludes selected From LLP
Amount (lbs) number input: min 1, max 10,000,000, step 100
Transfer Date date picker: defaults to today, max today
Available quota display updates when From LLP and Species selected

userStories.title: Implement Transfer Validation
userStories.description: As a manager, I want real-time validation so that I cannot submit invalid transfers.
acceptanceCriteria: From and To cannot be the same LLP (error: Cannot transfer to same vessel)
Amount must be > 0 (error: Amount must be greater than 0)
Amount cannot exceed available quota (error: Insufficient quota. Available: X lbs)
All required fields must be filled
Submit button disabled until form is valid
Validation errors shown inline below fields (red text)

userStories.title: Implement Transfer Submission
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to submit transfers so that quota moves between vessels.
acceptanceCriteria: Request body: from_llp, to_llp, species_code, pounds, transfer_date, notes
Server validates: sufficient quota, different LLPs, valid species
On success: toast notification, form resets, history refreshes
On error: toast with error message, form preserved
Submit button shows loading spinner during request

userStories.title: Build Transfer History Table
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to see transfer history so that I can review past movements.
acceptanceCriteria: Columns: Date, From (LLP + Vessel), To (LLP + Vessel), Species, Amount, Notes, Created By
Filter by date range (last 30 days default)
Search by vessel name or LLP

userStories.title: Add Transfer Export
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to export transfer history so that I can share records.
acceptanceCriteria: Export dropdown with CSV, Excel, PDF options
PDF: formatted table with title and date range
Exports filtered data based on current filters

userStories.title: Create Alerts Page Structure
userStories.description: As a manager, I want an alerts page so that I can manage bycatch notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Pending tab shows count badge (e.g., Pending (3))

userStories.title: Build Alert List View
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to see alerts in a list so that I can review and act on them.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card shows: Species, Status badge, Vessel (LLP), Amount, Location (DMS format)
Status badges: yellow Pending, green Shared, blue Resolved, red Dismissed
Shared alerts show: shared timestamp, recipient count
Resolved alerts show: resolved timestamp, resolved by

userStories.title: Add Alert Filters
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to filter alerts so that I can find specific ones.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter row: Cooperative dropdown, Species dropdown, Date range picker
Species shows PSC species only (Halibut, Cod, Sablefish, Thornyhead)
Date range defaults to last 30 days

userStories.title: Build Create Alert Form
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to create alerts on behalf of vessels so that I can report bycatch.
acceptanceCriteria: Vessel (LLP) dropdown: LLP - Vessel Name format
Amount input: min 1, label changes based on species unit (lbs/count)
Coordinate input supports both decimal and DMS format
Create button submits, Cancel closes modal

userStories.title: Implement Alert Sharing
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to share alerts with the fleet so that vessels are notified.
acceptanceCriteria: Share button on pending alert cards
Clicking opens preview modal showing email content
Preview shows: subject line, body text, recipient count
Send to Fleet button triggers email
On success: alert moves to Shared tab, toast notification

userStories.title: Implement Alert Resolution
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to resolve alerts so that I can mark hotspots as no longer active.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolve button on shared alert cards
Confirmation dialog: Mark this alert as resolved?
On success: alert moves to Resolved tab, toast notification

userStories.title: Implement Alert Dismissal
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to dismiss alerts so that I can remove irrelevant reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Dismiss button on pending alert cards
Confirmation dialog with optional reason field

userStories.title: Create My Vessel Page
userStories.description: As a vessel owner, I want to see my vessel's quota status so that I can plan trips.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows only data for user's linked LLP
Redirect to 403 if user has no linked LLP

userStories.title: Build Vessel Quota Cards
userStories.description: As a vessel owner, I want to see my remaining quota per species so that I know my limits.
acceptanceCriteria: 3 cards in a row: POP, NR, Dusky
Each card shows: remaining lbs, % of allocation
Color-coded by risk: red<10%, yellow 10-50%, green>50%

userStories.title: Build Vessel Transfer History
userStories.description: As a vessel owner, I want to see my transfer history so that I can verify movements.
acceptanceCriteria: Table columns: Date, Direction (IN/OUT), Species, Amount, Other Vessel
IN transfers styled green with Received from label
OUT transfers styled red with Sent to label

userStories.title: Build Vessel Harvest Records
userStories.description: As a vessel owner, I want to see my harvest records so that I can verify catches.
acceptanceCriteria: Table columns: Date, Species, Pounds, Processor
Note explaining data source: Data synced from eLandings

userStories.title: Create Report Bycatch Page
userStories.description: As a vessel owner, I want to report bycatch encounters so that I can alert my co-op.

userStories.title: Build Bycatch Report Form
userStories.description: As a vessel owner, I want a simple form to report bycatch so that I can submit quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: GPS Latitude input with Alaska validation (50-72N)
GPS Longitude input with Alaska validation (130-180W)
Amount input: label based on species unit
Success message: Report submitted. Your co-op manager will review.

userStories.title: Show Recent Reports
userStories.description: As a vessel owner, I want to see my recent reports so that I can track their status.
acceptanceCriteria: Section below form: Your Recent Reports
Shows last 5 reports from this vessel
Each shows: species, amount, location, date, status emoji
Status: hourglass Pending, checkmark Shared, x Dismissed

userStories.title: Create Upload Page Structure
userStories.description: As a manager, I want an upload page so that I can import eLandings data.
acceptanceCriteria: Two sections: Account Balance Upload, Catch Detail Upload

userStories.title: Build Account Balance Upload
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to upload balance CSV files so that I can import eFish snapshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows success count and any errors

userStories.title: Implement Balance CSV Processing
userStories.description: As a developer, I want CSV processing logic so that balance files are imported correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates columns: Balance Date, Account Id, Account Name, Species Group, etc.
Checks for duplicates in file (warns but allows)
Checks for duplicates in DB (prevents import of existing)
Returns: imported count, skipped count, errors array

userStories.title: Build Catch Detail Upload
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to upload detail XLSX files so that I can import catch records.

userStories.title: Implement Detail XLSX Processing
userStories.description: As a developer, I want XLSX processing logic so that detail files are imported correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses XLSX using a library (e.g., xlsx or exceljs)
Handles Excel date formats (converts to ISO)
Returns: imported count, skipped count, errors array

userStories.title: Create Account Balances View
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to view imported balances so that I can review reconciliation data.
acceptanceCriteria: Table showing latest balance per coop/species
Columns: Co-Op, Species, Balance Date, Initial, Transfers In/Out, Total, Catch, Remaining, % Taken

userStories.title: Create Catch Detail View
userStories.description: As a manager, I want to view imported catch details so that I can audit records.
acceptanceCriteria: Table showing all imported catch records
Columns: Date, Vessel, ADFG, Species, Weight, Processor, Report #

userStories.title: Create Rosters Page with Tabs
userStories.description: As a user, I want a rosters page so that I can view reference data.
acceptanceCriteria: Tabs: Cooperatives, Members, Vessels, Processors, Species

userStories.title: Build Cooperatives Tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view cooperatives so that I can see org structure.

userStories.title: Build Members Tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view coop members so that I can see LLP assignments.
acceptanceCriteria: Table columns: Coop, LLP, Company Name, Vessel, Representative

userStories.title: Build Vessels Tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view vessels so that I can see fleet details.
acceptanceCriteria: Table columns: Coop, Vessel Name, ADFG Number, Is Active

userStories.title: Build Processors Tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view processors so that I can see processing facilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Table columns: Name, Code, Associated Coop

userStories.title: Build Species Tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view species codes so that I can reference them.
acceptanceCriteria: Table columns: Code, Name, Is PSC, Unit

userStories.title: Create Allocations Page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view allocations so that I can see quota assignments.
acceptanceCriteria: Tabs: TAC Summary, Vessel Allocations, PSC Allocations

userStories.title: Build TAC Summary Tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view annual TAC so that I can see total limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Table columns: Species, TAC (mt), QS Pool %, TAC (lbs)

userStories.title: Build Vessel Allocations Tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view vessel allocations so that I can see starting quotas.
acceptanceCriteria: Table columns: Coop, LLP, Vessel, POP, NR, Dusky, Total
All amounts in lbs with formatting

userStories.title: Build PSC Allocations Tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view PSC allocations so that I can see bycatch limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Table showing Halibut CV sector allocation

userStories.title: Implement CSV Export Utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a CSV export utility so that tables can be exported consistently.

userStories.title: Implement Excel Export Utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I want an Excel export utility so that tables can be exported as .xlsx.

userStories.title: Implement PDF Export Utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a PDF export utility so that tables can be exported as formatted PDFs.
acceptanceCriteria: Proper page breaks for long tables

userStories.title: Add Export to All Data Tables
userStories.description: As a user, I want export buttons on all tables so that I can download data.

userStories.title: Set Up Sentry Error Tracking
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Sentry configured so that errors are tracked in production.
acceptanceCriteria: User context attached to errors (user_id, org_id, role)

userStories.title: Create Error Boundary Components
userStories.description: As a user, I want graceful error handling so that the app doesn't crash completely.
acceptanceCriteria: Global error boundary in root layout
Feature-level error boundaries for each major section
Error UI shows: Something went wrong, Retry button, Report link

userStories.title: Implement Toast Notification System
userStories.description: As a user, I want toast notifications so that I receive feedback on actions.

userStories.title: Create Loading States
userStories.description: As a user, I want loading indicators so that I know when data is being fetched.
acceptanceCriteria: Skeleton components for cards and tables
Spinner component for buttons and small areas

userStories.title: Set Up Vercel Analytics
userStories.description: As a developer, I want analytics so that I can monitor performance.

userStories.title: Set Up Vitest for Unit Tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a unit test framework so that I can test components and utilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Test utilities for rendering with providers

userStories.title: Write Unit Tests for Auth Hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want auth hooks tested so that authentication logic is verified.

userStories.title: Write Unit Tests for Data Utilities
userStories.description: As a developer, I want utility functions tested so that calculations are verified.

userStories.title: Set Up Playwright for E2E Tests

acceptanceCriteria: Test database or mocks for E2E

acceptanceCriteria: Test: successful login redirects to dashboard
Test: protected route redirects when not logged in

userStories.title: Write E2E Tests for Transfer Flow

acceptanceCriteria: Test: create transfer with valid data succeeds

acceptanceCriteria: Test: dismiss alert removes from view

userStories.description: As a developer, I want Vercel configured so that the app deploys automatically.

userStories.description: As a developer, I want environment configs so that dev/staging/prod are separate.
acceptanceCriteria: Separate Supabase project for production (or same with caution)

CONTRIBUTING.md with: code style, PR process, testing requirements

acceptanceCriteria: Screenshots or GIFs for key workflows
